main_commit.message:
Revert "lowering: a build reports a view that escapes its source as E065, and the corpus records it"

This reverts commit 0a48f9551d9924cab727183604e26e6aa2d133fb.

That commit added two conformance cases that the front end accepts and
the lowering refuses with E065, `diag_e065_array_reassigned` and
`diag_e065_map_reassigned`. TestSelfHostIRVerifyProvidedCorpusClean
takes each case with no `expected.error` and requires it to lower, so
both cases fail it on main: the driver exits with 3 and no verdict.

The commit also made `semlower.substitution` give a view escape to its
caller as a refused claim and return with no bodies. The CLI reads the
claims. The driver of that test does not, and it stops with
"no typed body".

The commit put three case names in one cell of the E065 row and of the
ML-04 row of the spec. Each index test reads that cell as one name, so
TestDiagnosticsIndexIsAccurate and TestSemanticsIndexIsAccurate fail.

I did not run these tests before #15205, which merged before its suite
ran. A correct repair of #14597 must first decide how a case that the
lowering refuses enters the corpus sweep, and each driver that reads a
substitution must read its refused claims. #14597 is open again with
that finding.

Refs #14597.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
